$comment: The video canvas and its rules, shared by the Remotion library (src/lib/tokens.ts) and the Python tools (tools/common.py BRAND). Change a value here, never a copy of it. DESIGN.md explains each one.

safe.$comment: Instagram's UI covers the rest: no text above top (progress bar, account) or below bottom (reply bar, Reel caption), nor closer than side to the edges. Images may run into them; words never do.

stickerBand.$comment: Stories: the owner puts Instagram's link sticker at the top, over y 0-250, for the whole clip. Nothing enters it on any frame; review.py band measures it and allows no content above bottom + margin.

reelSafe.$comment: Reels: the margins Instagram's Reel UI covers at 1080x1920 (top: the header; bottom: the caption, the audio line and the buttons' base; right: the like, comment and share column; left: a little). review.py reel warns when content enters them. Text keeps to both these and safe: x 80-960, y 250-1580.

beat.$comment: The default tempo for a video's grid when its video.json has no music.bpm.

loudness.$comment: Integrated loudness targets (LUFS) per soundtrack, the true-peak ceiling loudnorm aims for and the one mix.py enforces (dBTP), and how far off target a mix may land (LU).
